observations: The except ValueError block at lines 4-5 returns None instead of re-raising, so the ValueError is swallowed and converted into a normal return value.
The standard s1 requires logging the input error and re-raising the same exception, and explicitly forbids hiding failure as a normal return; the changed lines 4-5 violate both parts.
The logger parameter is accepted at line 1 but never used anywhere in the function, so no error is recorded as the standard requires.
The behavior contract states logger.error returns normally, so a compliant implementation could log and re-raise without the logger itself raising.
Probe p1 (operation raising ValueError) would return None under the current code, whereas the standard expects the ValueError to propagate to the caller.
No static findings are reported, so the defect is only observable through the changed lines 4-5 and the standard text.
